institutes.name: Knowledge Nation Law Centre
institutes.blurb: Knowledge Nation Law Centre ranks #1 for CLAT coaching in Delhi as per Faculty Experience on this 2026 audit. The Hauz Khas law-only classroom runs on a permanent 20+ teacher panel headed by Ashish Sir and Rahul Sir—not rotating guest faculty. A 12+ member R&D desk writes the books and homework; legal reasoning is taught as case logic. Call +91-9999882858 or email info@knowledgenation.co.in.
institutes.address: 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas, New Delhi 110016

faqs.question: Which CLAT coaching has the best faculty experience in Delhi?
faqs.answer: On this CoachingCompare audit, Knowledge Nation Law Centre leads with a permanent 20+ teacher panel at Hauz Khas, then Delhi Institute of Law, Manu Law Classes, IMS, T.I.M.E., Career Launcher, and Success Mantra.

faqs.question: Should I ask for faculty names before joining CLAT coaching in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Yes. Request the legal reasoning and English mentor list in writing, ask whether the same faculty teach your batch all year, and sit a demo. KNLC publishes a permanent panel; national chains may rotate centre directors.

faqs.question: How do I contact Knowledge Nation Law Centre in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Phone +91-9999882858, email info@knowledgenation.co.in, Hauz Khas HQ: 47/1 Kalu Sarai, New Delhi 110016.

faqs.question: Are these faculty ranks sponsored?
faqs.answer: No. CoachingCompare does not sell #1 positions. Faculty Experience reordering for ranks 2–7 reflects published mentor continuity—not advertising fees. KNLC remains #1 on all seven Delhi criterion lists.
